test_vectors.coverage: Exact empty, Unicode, CR/LF, raw HTML, entity, link, code delimiter, backslash, and preserved non-newline control-character escape vectors.
Every ASCII character, full punctuation escaping, public versus bounded writer equivalence, exact expansion limits, and one-byte-short failures.
Exact empty service and error documents, default option escaping, media types, and one terminating newline.

Exact full document bytes with title, version, description, service identity, endpoint code, public roles, ordered field tables, outer optionality, HTML and table escaping, and independent stream type information.

Integration with Wave 1 selection and Wave 2 MCP catalogs for Public, All, exact and unmatched roles, case sensitivity, empty grants, service omission, input order, stable bytes, and input immutability.

Adversarial document options, endpoint descriptions and roles, top-level field names and descriptions, and nested struct metadata cannot create raw HTML, headings, links, code spans, or new table cells.

All ABI EndpointType variants, named references, struct tables, NanoId lengths 1 and 255, empty definitions, prefixed enum displays, signed enum extrema, nested wrappers, and agreement with public Wave 2 type validation.
Optional arrays, arrays of optional values, required Unit fields, role order, and field order.

Hidden invalid NanoId lengths, unresolved request and streaming references, duplicate response fields and endpoint codes, service mismatch, duplicate roles, and empty roles retain canonical errors even with a zero output limit.
Invalid service and endpoint identifiers, duplicate service IDs and names, duplicate endpoint names, and cross-service duplicate endpoint codes agree with frozen root validation.

Integration across Markdown, MCP, OpenAPI, and AsyncAPI verifies endpoint identities and codes, exact visibility, absence of hidden metadata, streaming-only channels, and separate immediate response and stream types.

Wrong registry kinds, invalid or duplicate definition identities, cross-kind collisions, empty and duplicate field names, invalid enum variant identifiers, duplicate enum names and values, unresolved references, invalid reference identifiers, and wrong-kind references agree with Wave 2 canonical errors.
Accepted exact registered inline copies, rejected conflicting copies, references to inline definitions declared in hidden endpoints, and rejected duplicate inline declarations across endpoints.
Zero depth rejection, exact primitive and wrapper depth boundaries, hidden streaming depth violations, finite recursive named references, and u16::MAX limits.
256 owned wrappers, exact structural depth bounds, stack-based equality of registered inline copies, and deeper use-site bounds for otherwise equal definitions.
Exact i32 minimum, zero, and maximum code text, identifier punctuation escaping, adversarial descriptions, Unicode, ordering, deterministic bytes, and immutability.
Empty, numeric-leading, punctuation, whitespace, HTML, Unicode, newline, and NUL error names; duplicate codes and duplicate names; validation precedence over output limits.

Exact required unit directives, separately quoted arguments including an empty argument, optional User and WorkingDirectory, spaces in directory paths, u32::MAX RestartSec, stable bytes, final newline, and immutability.

Exact systemd word quoting for empty strings, whitespace, percent specifiers, environment syntax, backslashes, double quotes, semicolons, shell punctuation, and Unicode; full executable and argument vectors; exact and short output bounds.

Scalar Description and WorkingDirectory use percent escaping without command argument quoting, preserve literal quotes and backslashes, protect trailing backslashes from line continuation, and preserve directory components ending in a space through an equivalent /. suffix.
Every Unicode control character in U+0000 through U+009F is rejected in description, executable, arguments, user, and working directory; explicit directive and section injection vectors are rejected.
Empty and relative executable and directory paths, Windows and home shorthand paths, unsafe and non-ASCII users, permitted ASCII user forms, and zero-second restart delay.
Every byte limit from zero through one byte above the expected length for all three document generators, including multibyte Unicode, escaping expansion, integer bounds, and final newlines.

Large hidden endpoint metadata and unused registry descriptions do not consume the visible Markdown budget or require intermediate schema allocation; including hidden endpoints still enforces the output bound.

Exact i64 minimum and maximum, u32 maximum, i32 minimum, negative and decimal transition vectors, atomic rejected numeric and UTF-8 appends, empty appends at capacity, zero capacity, and canonical allocation failure classification.

status.validation: Source reviewed against the frozen contract, canonical ABI, and prior-wave implementations. No build, check, compiler, formatter, test, or commit command was run, as instructed.
status.scope: Only crates/jmax-codegen-spec/src/markdown.rs and reports/wave4/W4-26.json were written.
status.runtime: no_std plus alloc; no added dependencies, unsafe code, global state, runtime I/O, or process creation
status.allocation: Fallible projections reserve String and traversal Vec storage with try_reserve and map allocation failures to BudgetExhausted. The mandated infallible escape_markdown convenience function retains ordinary String allocation behavior.
